The Standard plan is recommended for most users due to its generous storage and advanced features like noise cancellation in Meet calls. **Google** Workspace also offers a new tool called Workspace Flows that uses AI-powered agents called Gems to automate tasks and workflows within the suite. Users can access a free trial of **Google** Workspace for 14 days, with the option to continue after the trial period.
